review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Proceed with this design before the replacement branch implementation commit
review.notes: Reviewed official Apple full-canvas versus critical-safe-area requirements, enlarged auxiliary device art, and four test failure oracles. PR1890 H62b26796 already contained these tests without required design/catalogue; its failed history remains preserved and is not retrospectively approved. This replacement branch records this actual self-review before applying the implementation. Final independent review remains required.

evidence_limits: Pure Node geometry guards, not actual App Store or device previews.
Screenshot truthfulness and reading hierarchy require separate image review.
